rationale: Codex 39d7179c is the only implementation whose containment probe records from inside the Codex and Cursor sandboxes (clone-local .coord mailbox ingested by the run loop) and whose static parser scopes cd to subshells and pipelines, while the byte-identical claude 64ace635 and cursor da473de2 pins cannot record probes under those sandboxes and allow '(cd /tmp) && git status' in the clone; codex's remaining defects (unconditional per-action probe note at runLoop.ts:727 and control-keyword git calls at shellGuard.ts:173) are small, fail-safe revisions.
